base_member_text: L948, L997: SCANASER's loop variable is NA but its label-20 error message prints NS, which is never assigned in this subroutine - the series number in the error text is undefined.
audit_member_text: use-before-assign/copy-paste: SCANASER의 오류 진단은 실제 series loop 변수 NA가 아니라 선언 후 대입되지 않은 NS를 출력한다(L927,L997-L998). 또한 SUNDAY.INP에서 master만 NDASER를 늘리지만(L982-L991) 그 뒤 NDASER 방송 없이 반환한다.
dispositions.rationale: SCANASER prints unassigned NS not loop var NA; B adds NDASER post-read broadcast gap
dispositions.decided_by: llm:claude-opus-4-8 (pilot; self-adjudicated, UNBLINDED — mechanics validation only)

base_member_text: L2062-L2085 (SCANSEDZLJ): read errors are detected only by 'ERROR == 1'; other nonzero IOSTAT values (including negative end-of-file codes) bypass the handlers.
audit_member_text: 특이 I/O 검사 무력화: SCANSEDZLJ의 네 read는 IOSTAT를 받은 뒤 ERROR==1만 오류로 취급한다(L2059-L2080). Fortran의 다른 양수 오류 코드 및 음수 EOF는 이 검사에 걸리지 않아 후속 값이 미정일 수 있다.
dispositions.rationale: SCANSEDZLJ read errors gated on ERROR==1; other IOSTAT/EOF bypass handlers
dispositions.decided_by: llm:claude-opus-4-8 (pilot; self-adjudicated, UNBLINDED — mechanics validation only)

base_member_text: L1590, L1935-L1948: FNWQSR is dimensioned 40 and filled to index 19+NALGAE+NZOOPL with no bound check; behavior when NALGAE+NZOOPL > 21 is not resolvable in-file.
audit_member_text: 범위 초과 가능성: FNWQSR과 FNWQSRALGAE는 40개로 고정 선언되어 있지만(L1588-L1589), NWQV=19+NALGAE+NZOOPL을 상한 검사 없이 사용하고 FNWQSR(1:NWQV)을 순회한다(L1627 부근,L1954,L1981). NALGAE+NZOOPL>21이면 배열 범위를 넘는다.
dispositions.rationale: FNWQSR fixed dim 40 filled to 19+NALGAE+NZOOPL with no bound check
dispositions.decided_by: llm:claude-opus-4-8 (pilot; self-adjudicated, UNBLINDED — mechanics validation only)

base_member_text: L25-L26: module-level 'character(*) :: STR*200' and 'CFILE*15' declare assumed-length characters with length specs but no parameter attribute - nonstandard Fortran; how the target compilers treat this is not resolvable in-file.
dispositions.rationale: assumed-length char with length spec, no parameter attr — nonstandard
dispositions.decided_by: llm:claude-opus-4-8 (pilot; self-adjudicated, UNBLINDED — mechanics validation only)

base_member_text: L904: SCANGWSR sizes each groundwater series record as 3+NDYE+NSED+NSND+NTOX values with in-line comment 'DELME - WQ' - WQ constituents are not part of the scan count; whether GWSER.INP may carry WQ columns is not resolvable here.
dispositions.decided_by: llm:claude-opus-4-8 (pilot; self-adjudicated, UNBLINDED — mechanics validation only)

base_member_text: L1410-L1415 (SCANWRSER): error label 20 prints the read-error message but has no STOPP and falls through into label 40's 'UNEXPECTED END' message before stopping - the reported reason at label 20 is misleading.
dispositions.rationale: SCANWRSER label-20 error falls through to label-40 message before STOPP
dispositions.decided_by: llm:claude-opus-4-8 (pilot; self-adjudicated, UNBLINDED — mechanics validation only)

base_member_text: L1902 vs L1904: file opened is 'WQPSL.INP' but ERRSTR reads 'READING WPQSL.INP' (transposed) - error text does not match the file name.
dispositions.decided_by: llm:claude-opus-4-8 (pilot; self-adjudicated, UNBLINDED — mechanics validation only)

base_member_text: L811: inside the NWSER > 1 block, Broadcast_Scalar(NWSER, ...) re-broadcasts a value already broadcast at L226; whether this is defensive or vestigial is not stated.
dispositions.rationale: NWSER re-broadcast — defensive vs vestigial unresolved
dispositions.decided_by: llm:claude-opus-4-8 (pilot; self-adjudicated, UNBLINDED — mechanics validation only)

audit_member_text: MPI 전파 누락 가능성: C45E에서 master가 TOXDEP(NT).TXDRY와 TXWET까지 읽지만(L482 부근), 뒤에서는 ITXDRY와 ITXWET 플래그만 방송한다(L485-L486). 비-master가 실제 건·습식 침적값을 사용하는 경로가 있다면 rank 간 값이 달라진다.
dispositions.rationale: C45E TOXDEP TXDRY/TXWET read but only ITXDRY/ITXWET flags broadcast (MPI)
dispositions.decided_by: llm:claude-opus-4-8 (pilot; self-adjudicated, UNBLINDED — mechanics validation only)

audit_member_text: MPI 전파 누락 가능성: C46에서 VOL_VEL_MAX와 VOL_DEP_MIN을 master가 읽지만(L493 부근), 이어지는 방송 목록(L496-L503)에 두 값이 없다.
dispositions.rationale: C46 VOL_VEL_MAX/VOL_DEP_MIN read, absent from broadcast list (MPI)
dispositions.decided_by: llm:claude-opus-4-8 (pilot; self-adjudicated, UNBLINDED — mechanics validation only)

audit_member_text: MPI 인터페이스 불일치: MODCHAN.INP에서 master가 MDCHH,MDCHHD,MDCHHD2를 함께 읽은 뒤(L791 부근) MDCHH만 방송한다(L794 부근). 뒤의 두 전역값은 비-master에서 동기화되지 않는다.
dispositions.rationale: MODCHAN MDCHH/MDCHHD/MDCHHD2 read, only MDCHH broadcast (MPI)
dispositions.decided_by: llm:claude-opus-4-8 (pilot; self-adjudicated, UNBLINDED — mechanics validation only)

audit_member_text: MPI unit 수명 불일치: SCANDSER는 DSER.INP를 master에서만 연다(L1192 부근)지만 close(1)은 master 조건 밖에서 모든 rank가 실행한다(L1227). 비-master가 열지 않은 unit 1을 닫을 수 있다.
dispositions.rationale: SCANDSER opens DSER.INP master-only but close(1) on all ranks
dispositions.decided_by: llm:claude-opus-4-8 (pilot; self-adjudicated, UNBLINDED — mechanics validation only)

audit_member_text: MPI 전파 누락 가능성: SCANWQ의 JSON point-source loop는 master에서만 NCSERM을 ITMP로 늘린다(L1768-L1778 부근). 이후 공통 경로의 NCSERM=max(NCSERM,NWQCSRM)(L1842)은 그 master-only 증가분을 비-master에 전달하지 않는다.
dispositions.rationale: SCANWQ master-only NCSERM increment not propagated (MPI)
dispositions.decided_by: llm:claude-opus-4-8 (pilot; self-adjudicated, UNBLINDED — mechanics validation only)

audit_member_text: MPI 상태 불일치: wq_biota.jnp의 use_hydro_feedback 경로는 master에서 MACDRAG=1 및 ISVEG=2로 바꾸지만(L1859-L1860), 뒤에서는 ISMOB와 IVARSETL만 방송한다(L1870-L1871). allocation flag로 쓰인다는 주석과 달리 rank별 ISVEG/MACDRAG가 달라질 수 있다.
dispositions.rationale: wq_biota master sets MACDRAG/ISVEG but broadcasts only ISMOB/IVARSETL
dispositions.decided_by: llm:claude-opus-4-8 (pilot; self-adjudicated, UNBLINDED — mechanics validation only)

audit_member_text: use-before-assign: FNWQSR(40)은 ISWQLVL==1 분기에서만 채워지고(L1933-L1948), ISWQLVL==0용 초기화 코드는 주석 처리돼 있다(L1924-L1930). 그럼에도 모든 옵션에서 FNWQSR(NW)를 INQUIRE/OPEN에 사용한다(L1955-L1985). kinetic option 0에서 미초기화 문자열을 파일명으로 사용한다.
dispositions.rationale: FNWQSR uninitialized in ISWQLVL==0 path yet used as filename
dispositions.decided_by: llm:claude-opus-4-8 (pilot; self-adjudicated, UNBLINDED — mechanics validation only)

audit_member_text: MPI 전파 누락: SCANSEDZLJ는 master가 KB,ICALC_BL뿐 아니라 SEDSTEP,SEDSTART,IHTSTRT,IMORPH,ISWNWAVE,MAXDEPLIMIT,HPMIN도 읽지만(L2065), 방송은 KB,ICALC_BL,ITBM,NSICM 네 값뿐이다(L2085-L2088). 나머지 설정이 비-master에서 사용되는지 확인이 필요하다.
dispositions.rationale: SCANSEDZLJ reads SEDSTEP/.../HPMIN but broadcasts only 4 values (MPI)
dispositions.decided_by: llm:claude-opus-4-8 (pilot; self-adjudicated, UNBLINDED — mechanics validation only)

audit_member_text: 조건부 미대입 방송: SCNTXSED는 각 NN에서 NCSERNC=0으로 초기화하지만 NLOOP는 해당 독성/퇴적물/모래 조건이 참일 때만 대입한다(L2104-L2125). 조건이 거짓이어도 NLOOP를 즉시 방송한다(L2128), 따라서 미정값을 MPI 호출 인자로 전달한다.
dispositions.rationale: SCNTXSED broadcasts NLOOP even when left unassigned
dispositions.decided_by: llm:claude-opus-4-8 (pilot; self-adjudicated, UNBLINDED — mechanics validation only)

audit_member_text: SCANEFDC의 C67은 ISPD만 읽은 뒤 NPDM=max(1,NPD)를 계산한다(L535-L541 부근). 이 루틴 안에서 NPD 대입이 보이지 않으므로 GLOBAL의 선행 초기화에 의존하는지 확인이 필요하다.
dispositions.rationale: SCANEFDC C67 NPDM=max(1,NPD) with NPD not assigned in routine
dispositions.decided_by: llm:claude-opus-4-8 (pilot; self-adjudicated, UNBLINDED — mechanics validation only)

audit_member_text: 복붙/중복 후보: C22 뒤 Broadcast_Scalar(NDYE,master_id)가 같은 블록에서 두 번 호출된다(L299와 L303 부근). 기능상 무해할 수 있으나 인접 방송 목록의 누락을 가리는 복사 흔적이다.
dispositions.rationale: C22 Broadcast_Scalar(NDYE) called twice — copy trace
dispositions.decided_by: llm:claude-opus-4-8 (pilot; self-adjudicated, UNBLINDED — mechanics validation only)
